name: Andorra
exam_name: Apreciació de la suficient integració a Andorra

unverified.administering_agency: The pages read name the Government; the body that assesses integration is set by a regulation (Reglament per a l’apreciació de la suficient integració a Andorra, 3-5-96, amended 27-3-2019) that was not read.
unverified.format: Set by the same regulation, which was not read.
unverified.fee: The procedure page lists passport fees only; none for the assessment.
unverified.official_study_material: None found on the pages read.
unverified.exemptions: The procedure page asks for the Catalan B1 diploma only of people under 70; nothing read about the integration assessment itself.

notes: Applicants must prove their integration. The procedure page asks for a B1 Catalan diploma and, "if held", the Diploma de ciències humanes i socials d’Andorra; how integration is assessed for those without it is in a regulation not read here. A press report (not a source) says the diploma course stands in for the assessment.
